Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 18 September 2026 18 September 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 14-Sep-2026 288,878 252.4956 250.4000 254.0000 15-Sep-2026 283,498 252.5375 248.6000 255.2000 16-Sep-2026 272,688 257.7053 254.4000 259.0000 17-Sep-2026 243,112 260.9364 258.0000 262.2000 18-Sep-2026 243,147 258.4001 256.8000 261.6000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 966,056,686 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 36,689,328 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 18 September 2026 is 966,056,686 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 8,238,863 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
